smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: REimagineHome
shortDescription: Turns a room photo into a renovation preview. New accounts get 5 free designs.
longDescription: REimagineHome interior renovation takes a room photo and a description, then changes surfaces, colors, and decor while leaving the architecture in place. New accounts get 5 free designs with no card. Paid plans are monthly credit allowances. See their site for current pricing.
pricingNotes: New accounts get 5 free designs. Paid plans are monthly credit allowances. See their site for current pricing.
bestFor: A room photo that should become a renovation preview
An interior mockup that keeps the existing walls
notIdealFor: A blueprint that should become a whole-house 3D model
A measured floor plan for a listing
strength: REimagineHome turns a room photo into a renovation preview and keeps the room structure unless you ask to change it.
weakness: The free allowance is 5 designs, and the pricing page lists credit plans without a dollar amount in the plan body.
